Classic quotation excerpts used by the Bloom Isle homepage.

Dictionary of Quotations from Ancient and Modern, English and Foreign Sources.
Compiled by James Wood, 1893. Project Gutenberg eBook 48105.
Many Thoughts of Many Minds. Compiled by Louis Klopsch, 1896.
Project Gutenberg eBook 17112.
Memorabilia Mathematica; or, the Philomath's Quotation-Book.
Compiled by Robert Edouard Moritz, 1914. Project Gutenberg eBook 44730.
The Art of War. Sun Tzu, translated by Lionel Giles, 1910.
Project Gutenberg eBook 17405 (text without commentary).

The first three works are quotation anthologies. Their printed attributions
and, where available, references have been retained in the selection audit;
the anthology title must not be represented as a work by the quoted person.
English renderings follow these editions; no new Chinese translations were
manufactured. Whitespace and terminal punctuation have been normalized.
Full research snapshots are not deployed with the website.
Project Gutenberg's provided license is retained in LICENSE-Project-Gutenberg.txt.
Chinese classical texts from chinese-poetry retain LICENSE-chinese-poetry.txt.
